annotations.title: Get live jobs from one ATS board (free)

description:
WHAT: Fetch every job currently published on ONE company board from its official public ATS API (Greenhouse, Lever or Ashby), from Personio's documented XML feed, from Pinpoint's documented postings.json, or from a named Gem job board, normalize it and filter it locally.
WHEN: You know the board (ats + slug), e.g. from jobs_find_board or a careers-page link, and want its live openings now. For Personio, Pinpoint and Gem you already know the company account, subdomain or vanity.
WHEN NOT: One known job's full detail (jobs_get_job). Jobs in a place or by role across the starter list, without a company name (jobs_search_by_location). Do not ask the user for a company and do not call this tool or jobs_find_board first for that ask. Many companies at once, history (new/closed/reposted since last run), or careers-page discovery at scale: use jobs_search_companies (paid). Unknown Greenhouse/Lever/Ashby board: use jobs_find_board first. Personio, Pinpoint and Gem are never discovered. SmartRecruiters, LinkedIn, Workday, Workable, Recruitee and Rippling are not supported and never contacted.
BEHAVIOR: Runs on your machine. Greenhouse, Lever and Ashby: one GET to the documented API host only (very large Greenhouse boards: a second, lighter GET). Personio: robots.txt, then GET https://{account}.jobs.personio.de/xml only; all Personio accounts share one lane, one at a time, at least 1.5 s apart. Pinpoint: that tenant's robots.txt, then GET https://{subdomain}.pinpointhq.com/postings.json only (not jobs.json, not /api/v1); each subdomain is its own lane, one at a time, at least 1 s apart. Gem: GET https://api.gem.com/job_board/v0/{vanity}/job_posts/ only (no API key, no POST /applications); every vanity shares one lane, one at a time, at least 1 s apart. Pinpoint and Gem description_text stay empty (link out; the ad body is not copied). Gem job_url points at jobs.gem.com. Pinpoint job_url is the tenant listing link. Emails and phones are not kept from a Pinpoint posting. Nothing stored, no history: first_seen_at = now and change = null. Any HTTP 403/429 stops that host for the session (kill switch, HOST_BLOCKED error). A blocked Personio or Pinpoint host does not block other companies. A blocked Gem response stops api.gem.com for the session. Lever requests are spaced 1 s apart (its robots.txt Crawl-delay).
COST: No APIFY_TOKEN, no billing.
RETURNS: Paged "job" rows. compensation only when the ATS publishes it; posted_at is the ATS date or null (never guessed); age_basis says how age_days was derived.
PARAMETERS: All filters are AND-ed; values inside one filter are OR-ed. titleIncludes/titleExcludes match whole words ("engineer" does not match "Engineering"). countries uses the ATS's structured country where present (Lever, Ashby) and a place-name list otherwise; rows without any country are dropped when countries is set. postedWithinDays drops rows with posted_at = null. Paging re-fetches the board, so pages from different calls can shift if the employer edits the board in between.
EXAMPLE: {"ats":"ashby","slug":"ramp","titleIncludes":["engineer"],"remote":"only"} -> remote engineering roles at Ramp with salary ranges.

ats.description: Required. The applicant-tracking system hosting the board: "greenhouse" | "lever" | "ashby" | "personio" | "pinpoint" | "gem". Personio, Pinpoint and Gem are the account, subdomain or vanity you name, not a discovered board. Example: "ashby"

countries.description: Optional ISO-3166 alpha-2 codes, any-of, case-insensitive. Example: ["US","DE"]

includeDescription.description: Optional boolean, default false. true adds description_text (plain text, <= 20,000 chars, e-mails/phones removed)

locations.description: Optional, 0-50 strings, any-of. Substring match on location text. US state names and codes match both ways (FL and Florida); NYC, SF, LA, DC, Tampa Bay and other US metro aliases match. "remote" also matches ATS remote flags. Example: ["new york","berlin"]

longOpenDays.description: Optional integer, default 60: rows older than this get long_open = true (a heuristic, not proof of a ghost job)

offset.description: Optional items to skip, integer >= 0, default 0; pass nextOffset from the previous response

postedWithinDays.description: Optional integer 1-3650: keep jobs whose ATS publish date is at most this many days old. Example: 14

slug.description: Required. Board slug as it appears in the public board URL (case-insensitive): boards.greenhouse.io/{slug}, jobs.lever.co/{slug}, jobs.ashbyhq.com/{slug}, the Personio account in {account}.jobs.personio.de, the Pinpoint subdomain in {subdomain}.pinpointhq.com, or the Gem vanity in jobs.gem.com/{vanity}. Named feeds reject a dot. 1-100 chars. Example: "ramp" or "acme"

titleExcludes.description: Optional, 0-50 strings, any-of. Drop titles containing any of these. Example: ["intern","manager"]

titleIncludes.description: Optional, 0-50 strings, any-of. Keep titles containing any of these whole words/phrases, case-insensitive. Example: ["engineer","data scientist"]

name: jobs_get_board

count.description: Number of items in this page

hasMore.description: True if more items exist after this page

items.description: Result rows. Each has "type": "job" (job_key, title, company, locations, countries, remote, posted_at, verified_open_at, age_days, long_open, apply_url, source_url, ...), "board", "company", "seed_board", "open_check" or "error" (code, message, retryable)

meta.description: Tool-specific context: board totals, request counts, cost notes

nextOffset.description: Offset to pass for the next page, or null when done

offset.description: Offset of the first item in this page

total.description: Total items after filters, before paging
